lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Mira. Mira. Baker's back door's open.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: He'll hear you in the next valley, Tom.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Burnt ends. He throws them out at first light. If we're quick.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You're always quick. That's why you're thin.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Is Lily coming? She likes the crusts.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: No she's not. I looked.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: I did. She's not anywhere.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: Her blanket's still down. Go and look.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: She doesn't go anywhere without you.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: You were supposed to watch her. You said you would.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: ...Then go and find her.

lines.speaker: orphan_elsa
lines.text: No. You're all she had.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Stop it. Both of you.

lines.speaker: orphan_tom
lines.text: Mr. Holt's lamp was on all night. I saw it when I got up.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Holt doesn't burn oil for nothing.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Mira. You look like you've been looking.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Lily. Small. Dark hair. You know her.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: I know her.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Late last night. I couldn't sleep. The dogs wouldn't settle.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: A tall man. Not from here. He walked that lane like he'd walked it before.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Your girl went beside him. Boots on, shawl up. Quiet. Like she'd been told to.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Where.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Down the chapel lane. Past the graves. Into the pines.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: I called out. Twice. You sleep like the dead, child.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: By the time I had my boots on, they were gone.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Through the lychgate path. North, where the pines crowd close.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: You know that path well.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Sixty years here. I know all the paths.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Nobody I'd know.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Nobody you'd want to, either.

lines.speaker: neighbor_holt
lines.text: Wait in your doorway. Children wander. She'll turn up.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: They don't turn up, Holt. Not lately.

lines.speaker: lane_voice
lines.text: Go home, girl.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: A tall man came down here last night. With a little girl.

lines.speaker: lane_voice
lines.text: I sleep at night. Like decent folk.

lines.speaker: lane_voice
lines.text: You should try it.
